entries.topic: F1-94 PowerShell launcher and protected asset ACLs
entries.content: VERIFIED 2026-08-14. A .ps1 double-click is not a reliable Formula-90 launcher: this Windows profile registered Microsoft.PowerShellScript.1/Open to Notepad and had no RunWithPowerShell verb. Invoke the script explicitly with powershell.exe -NoProfile -File or provide a project-local launcher when double-click behavior is required. A separate F1-94 failure, Get-Content Access denied for game/assets/models/vehicles/f1_94/vehicle_runtime_manifest.json, was caused by protected file ACLs that did not inherit the folder permissions. Repair the exact vehicle folder with elevated ownership recovery, enable inheritance and grant the interactive user (OI)(CI) Modify recursively; then verify every asset is readable and run run_f1-94.ps1 -Smoke without Bypass. Whole-project Godot imports can still emit pre-existing Jordan 197 resource errors; F1-94 smoke PASS and process exit code 0 are the acceptance signal for this incident.
